gen-gf-aboreto-gf-noticia-text: Wide-spaced and swaggering, Aboreto towers over its page with bold strokes and hairline counterstrokes. And Noticia Text, a classic serif with generous entry curves, brings a low-contrast dignity that grounds it.
gen-gf-aboreto-gf-noto-serif-hentaigana: Noto Serif Hentaigana keeps its small letters tall and its curves open, with a subtle thick and thin cadence. Aboreto, meanwhile, pinches heavy curves into hairline ends, and the text serif simply carries on the quieter work.
gen-gf-aboreto-gf-ovo: Aboreto stretches its letters wide apart, with stark weight differences inside each stroke, while Ovo keeps a tall middle band and spacious curve terminals. The classic serif body is the steadier of the two.
gen-gf-aboreto-gf-piazzolla: Ink-heavy verticals joined by thread-thin diagonals give Aboreto a dramatic, widely spaced look at the top. Piazzolla follows with a classic serif whose lowercase nearly matches its capitals, and the opened e feels friendly beside it.
gen-gf-aboreto-gf-pridi: Commanding, wide, and a little theatrical, Aboreto pairs fat strokes with hairlines. Pridi, a text serif with small letters standing proud and generous gaps at curve ends, would keep a longer passage moving along comfortably without much resistance.
gen-gf-aboreto-gf-scope-one: Scope One is a text serif with counters that spill outward and stubby ascenders beside a big x-height. Scope One's sturdy, compact shapes are the strongest quality here, set against Aboreto's bold verticals and whisper-thin horizontals.
gen-gf-aboreto-gf-slabo-13px: Slabo 13px reads bookish and open, with large counters in its tall a, e and s. Slabo 13px, a classic serif, gives Aboreto's black stems and pale threads something sturdy to lean on.
gen-gf-aboreto-gf-suwannaphum: Suwannaphum, a text serif with a wide-open c and a high, squared-off x-height, sits under Aboreto's fat verticals and threadlike joins. Giving it a little extra size would help.
gen-gf-abyssinica-sil-gf-cascadia-code: Soft curves, short ascenders and big bowls give Abyssinica SIL a gentle, dignified lead over the wire-thin Cascadia Code. The sans keeps its neighbors well apart, so the page feels spacious.
gen-gf-abyssinica-sil-gf-cascadia-mono: Mild thick-thin shifts and short ascenders over big bowls make Abyssinica SIL feel smooth and unhurried. Cascadia Mono, a sans-serif with pin-like letters in a wide board, keeps a long passage moving at a plain, pressure-free pace.
